excerpt.zh: 我们应当学习如何安全地将一个行星辐射化，不给当地人群造成过大的不便。
excerpt.en: We shall study how to safely irradiate a planet, without unduly inconveniencing the local population.

texts.zh: 我们应当学习如何安全地将一个行星辐射化，不给当地人群造成过大的不便。
texts.en: We shall study how to safely irradiate a planet, without unduly inconveniencing the local population.

texts.zh: 我们的[This.GetResearchers]正在研究我们的工业将环境转为辐射化的整个过程，并承诺未来他们能够安全地将葱郁的生态系统转变为辐射环境，同时不会对当地人群造成过量的伤害。
texts.en: Our [This.GetResearchers] have studied the processes of irradiation our industries employ, and promise they will now be able to safely convert vibrant ecosystems into radioactive environments without causing excessive harm to the local population.

tooltips.zh: 我们现在可以通过环境改造将行星转变为死寂星球。
tooltips.en: We may now terraform planets into Tomb Worlds.
